Cute nekomata OC, it has been since 2022 I haven't updated it here, thinking it would be fine continuing it somewhere else...a mistake I'm correcting, still it has been awhile since I found new art from him on Pixiv or other places, maybe the OC master has been running low on funds?

Original desc: Its strange because I sometimes stumbled on some arts of this cute red nekomata nekomimi (nekomatamimi?) ninja OC that doesn't seem to do very well against tentacle monsters and very strong uncles.
